request: Sequence preserves acknowledged identifiers across promotion and recovery and issues consecutive identifiers. Storage and replication steps are supplied by the caller.

defects.description: Promotion replaces acknowledged state with a lagging snapshot.
defects.why_missed: Promotion is tested only after replication.

defects.description: Recovery resumes from the reserved endpoint rather than the issued value.
defects.why_missed: Recovery is tested only on empty storage.
